input.root_cause: A burst of command-spawned entities (SpawnReason COMMAND) flooded the world at about 07:20: about 452 pigs plus about 452 each of sand, cobblestone and flint item entities. I could not identify the source player or plugin. The logs only showed "[Pig: Summoned new Sand]" lines and RCON activity, and neither player had any logged commands.
input.actions: Watched status and saw entities jump from 24 to 1832. Declared the incident. Checked logs and entity data and found the entities were command-spawned. Ran kill commands on 452 pigs (sorted furthest, limit 452, which left 1 pig) and on the sand, cobblestone and flint item entities. About 122 items remain; I did not touch them (some are porkchop drops from the pig kills). Confirmed entities fell to 146, TPS 20 and MSPT about 1.4, with no regrowth.
input.residual_risk: The source of the spawning is unknown, so it could recur. The pig kill used sort=furthest with limit 452, so I can't rule out that one original pig was killed and one flood pig survived. About 122 leftover items (mostly porkchop) will despawn on their own. Someone should review whatever has RCON access.

I declared an entity-flood incident and cleared it without a restart. I couldn't find who or what caused it. The server is stable: TPS is 20, MSPT about 1.4, and the entity count has stayed at 146 with no regrowth.

- **What happened:** Around 07:20, entities jumped from 24 to 1832. They were command-spawned: about 452 pigs plus about 452 each of sand, cobblestone and flint items. The logs only showed "Summoned new Sand" lines and RCON activity, and neither online player had any logged commands. So the source is unknown and it could happen again.
- **What I did:** I killed the flood pigs and the sand, cobblestone and flint item entities. I banned no one, deleted no files and modified no files.
- **Possible mistake:** I killed pigs by distance (452 of 453), so I can't rule out that one original pig died and one flood pig survived.
- **Leftovers:** About 122 items remain, mostly porkchop dropped when the pigs died. I left them to despawn on their own.
- **Follow-up:** Someone should review whatever has RCON access.
